findings.label: Incorrect
findings.title: Done accepts design-only/generic reviews and ignores reviewed-source freshness

evidence.detail: Accepted reviewer set checks result/role/artifact/report hash only, with no CODE-review kind or reviewed-source binding.
Artifact verification authenticates current report bytes, not its review semantics or the current source hashes reviewed by it.
The existing missing-review/missing-clause test does not test design-only, generic-marker or stale-code reports.

observedTargetedCheck.input: One isolated static-clause card, two accepted other-role records with reviewKind=design, existing DECISIONS artifact hash, and stale zero scopedSourceHashes.
observedTargetedCheck.scope: Read-only validator correctness probe; no board/state file written.

findings.impact: The newly mandated two other-role CODE reviews can be bypassed by earlier design documents or a generic artifact. Later source changes do not invalidate review acceptance merely because the unchanged report still hashes correctly.
findings.requestedFix: Parse a defined code-review schema; require code kind, matching reviewer and reviewed-owner verdict, explicit scope/exclusions and current per-file/scope source hashes. Reject design-only/generic markers and changed source before counting an accepted code review. Add targeted negative tests while retaining live-clause/dependency checks.
findings.acceptance: Resolved and accepted for the current R1 fix-scoped code snapshot; no live certification or complete main review.

resolution.label: Verified

evidence.detail: Exported digest/envelope helpers enforce expected raw/board-policy mode, matching reviewer/accepted owner, required kind, completion-source coverage and scope hash.
Done counts only required review kind/owner and requires explicit completionSources.
Accepted JSON is parsed, each source digest/current scope is checked before Done.
Targeted design/generic/stale-scope and operational-board-policy regressions passed.

resolution.boardPolicyMode: Explicitly approved normalization protects schema/defaultStatus/phaseAwareConstructionApproved and excludes operational records/revision/sourceHashes. reviewSourceDigest was used for the stored policy hash.

findings.label: Incorrect
findings.title: Inventory physical host exceeds the approved six-host 32-character freeze

evidence.detail: The full inventory physical stem produces 33 characters with the canonical prefix, separator and six-hex discriminator.
The length validator checks only fulfillment/notify/aggregator, not the approved six-host set.
The related test likewise checks only the three Functions names.

observedTargetedCheck.input: frozenNames for the supplied subscription and centralus, followed by validateFrozenNames.
observedTargetedCheck.scope: Pure local naming functions, not Azure availability validation.

findings.impact: The generated/validated map contradicts the root's explicit six-host <=32 contract. This is an approved POC freeze mismatch, not a claim that Azure Web Apps universally have a 32-character name limit.
findings.requestedFix: Shorten the physical inventory stem and validate/test all six host names. Preserve canonical contoso-inventory-api and the deterministic discriminator; re-freeze the physical alias map.
findings.acceptance: Resolved and accepted for the approved six-host source contract; actual availability remains To Do.

evidence.detail: Inventory physical stem is inv; canonical role is retained.
All six host names are checked against <=32.
All-six and former 33-character inventory alias negatives passed.

findings.label: Incorrect
findings.title: Anonymous Portal page sessions exhaust authenticated-controller admission

evidence.detail: Unauthenticated Portal GETs allocate entries in the same capped 100-session map; expiry cleanup occurs only in session().
After control authorization succeeds, a new caller without an existing cookie still goes through the exhausted newSession cap.

observedTargetedCheck.input: Existing local fixture, 100 no-cookie GET /portal/ requests, then POST /portal/session whose injected control authorizer returns success.
observedTargetedCheck.expected: An independently authorized controller can establish its bounded session.
observedTargetedCheck.scope: Local session admission only. JWT cryptography, grants and live service behavior were deliberately not claimed by this probe.
observedTargetedCheck.cleanup: Owned local server and connections closed in finally; no token/cookie/config file persisted.

findings.impact: A small anonymous landing-request burst denies a fresh authorized controller the ability to start the demo. Stale entries also remain at this login path until another session() access performs expiry cleanup.
findings.requestedFix: Do not let unauthenticated page state consume the entire authenticated-control quota. Allocate/reserve authenticated capacity or use stateless public landing state, reap expiry at allocation/login, and bound unauthenticated admission independently. Keep fixed-actor authorization, rotation and CSRF intact.
findings.acceptance: Resolved and accepted for the corrected-source/session fix scope; live control identity/admission remains To Do.

resolution.label: Verified

evidence.detail: Expired entries are reaped at allocation/lookup; unauthenticated lookup returns stateless view and no cookie; allocation is bounded/authenticated and expiry-clamped.
Only successful fixed control authorization plus a still-active window leads to newSession.
Focused actual HTTP fixture passes 120 anonymous no-cookie landings, 100 authorized slots, overflow429, 16-minute advancement and fresh login without a landing cleanup call.

resolution.preservedControls: Fixed-actor authorization, origin, schema, window recheck, cookie rotation and CSRF remain independently enforced.

findings.label: Incorrect
findings.title: Browser run evidence contains prior-run dependencies and can select a stale reused-run result

evidence.detail: Dependency identities live in one rolling page/controller buffer, capped by shifting, not partitioned by run.
prepare() changes the requested run but does not clear/version dependencies or old result entries; dependencyIdentities() returns the whole retained buffer.
The adapter waits for any result under the ID and then copies all controller dependency identities into this run's pack.

observedTargetedCheck.method: Read-only source lifecycle/data-flow trace, not re-execution of the browser suite.
observedTargetedCheck.actual: On a second run using the same page, earlier retained dependency identities are still included by line118. Reusing a runId also permits the old results entry to satisfy line115 before the new request completes.
observedTargetedCheck.scope: Controller/adapter source semantics; no fabricated telemetry rows were used.

findings.impact: A run-labelled evidence pack is not exclusively fresh/current-run evidence. It can contain sibling/prior request identities, or an old backend result for a reused ID, contradicting the strict finite expected-set/current-evidence acceptance.
findings.requestedFix: Give each execution a version/nonce and a run-scoped observation buffer, or record a start offset and filter to current captured request/span IDs. Clear/reject reused result IDs before driving, prevent unrelated in-flight callback contamination, and require completion of the requested execution rather than existence of an old entry. Add a two-distinct-runs-on-one-page and reused-ID regression.
findings.acceptance: Resolved and accepted for the corrected-source/run isolation scope, backed by targeted actual Chromium fixtures; no Azure certification is implied.

resolution.label: Verified

evidence.detail: Current-run callback version check and bounded no-eviction dependency view.
Positive invocationVersion, result/dependency clearing, no reused/active/101st prepare acceptance; version is not a backend DTO field.
Request-send-time private context records the actual current run/version only on the intended POST; callback preserves that snapshot.
Prepare before observers, explicit driver rejection, matching-version completion, actual response and SDK dependency filter against current captured wire trace/span.
Sequential current-evidence isolation, reused-ID no-POST, delayed active-run replacement and page capacity regression.

resolution.nativeSsrCompatibility: Existing authenticated workload-only native SSR navigation regression passed within the selected four browser checks.
